run_identity_decision.rationale: Attempt 2 was rejected at CPU prefreeze by the independent prelaunch audit before any compute action, weight download, model output, or JarvisLabs resource existed; the attempt-2 receipt itself assessed the same-run-directory convention as contract-consistent. The v1/v2 configs, attempt-1/attempt-2 preregistrations, and both no-go receipts remain immutable rejected evidence in place.

hypothesis: The candidate-v2 (35M, 602/756) versus Qwen2.5-0.5B (663/756) gap cannot currently be attributed to parameter count versus pretraining-token budget. A matched-adaptation sweep over pinned base checkpoints (pythia-70m-deduped ~3e11 tokens; SmolLM2-135M ~2e12; SmolLM2-360M ~4e12) on the identical frozen Mobile Actions SFT recipe, scored on a fresh grouped selection split, separates the axes.
decision: Which base-model scale, and which axis (tokens versus parameters), the project adopts for the next post-training phase: the smallest configuration clearing a +3.0-point exact-match margin over the in-run candidate-v2 reference on the fresh selection split with schema validity >= 0.95 and zero truncations, missing predictions, and generation failures; otherwise explicit per-axis falsification.

attempt_3_corrections.P0-3: every challenger arm's complete downloadable snapshot is hash-pinned in the v3 config roster snapshot_files tables (model.safetensors SHA-256 obtained via read-only Hugging Face LFS metadata with no weight download; config.json, tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json, special_tokens_map.json, and generation_config.json where present hashed from small metadata files). verify_challenger_snapshot enforces exact file-set equality plus per-file byte size and SHA-256 after snapshot_download and before any tokenizer or weight load, iterating the config's own pin table so no advertised pin can be left unenforced; validate_snapshot_pins additionally cross-checks the previously advertised tokenizer_json_sha256/tokenizer_config_sha256/config_json_sha256 against the pin table at config load. The verified hashes are bound into snapshot-verification.json, arm-result.json, and result.json. Pin receipt: experiments/runs/20260805-1554-mobile-scale-sweep-s17/snapshot-pins.json.
attempt_3_corrections.P2-A: decoding_kwargs validates the frozen generation_config_overrides against the exact greedy contract at config load and the runner passes every non-null field explicitly to each challenger model.generate call; the generation summary records the explicitly passed overrides. Snapshot generation_config.json files are hash-verified where present; pythia-70m-deduped has none at its pinned revision and its absence is pinned through the frozen file set.
attempt_3_corrections.P2-B: per-fit measured-failure semantics are implemented as preregistered: non-finite training loss (MeasuredFitFailure) or CUDA out-of-memory during one fit's training or generation records that fit as completed=false with its failure class, and the run continues; an arm with zero completed fits is a measured arm failure recorded in the decision's measured_failed_arm_ids and can never be adopted; if every arm fails, build_decision returns an explicit all-arms-falsified decision. Integrity violations (hash mismatch, optimizer-step budget drift, ID-presentation or gold-audit drift) remain whole-run aborts.
attempt_3_corrections.P3-A: torch.manual_seed(17) and torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(17) are installed at run start; the config's seed_scope note records that no stochastic module exists on the honest path so the seed claim is exact rather than assumed
attempt_3_corrections.P3-B: environment_versions binds the python/huggingface_hub/safetensors/tokenizers/torch/transformers versions into result.json, aborting on any missing package; the launch tooling's environment.json remains the complete environment record
attempt_3_corrections.P3-C: consciously accepted without code change: the residual TOCTOU window between reference verification and file reads is narrowed by generate_manifest re-verifying every checkpoint hash inside the generation call, and exploiting the remainder requires concurrent write access on the remote host during the run, which no receipt-level binding can exclude
